verdict.rationale: Exa provides a well-documented public API (search, answer, websets, structured extraction) plus official SDKs (exa-js) with concrete code examples for driving it programmatically, corroborated by llms.txt/docs probes and community hands-on trial usage. missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (404s on all probed paths), which would round out machine-readable API documentation.
